title: Field guide demo: sexing a pied kingfisher
storyboard: Film: top-down hands flipping a bird field guide to the kingfisher plate, finger tracing breast bands

scenes.headline: Male or female? Your field guide knows
Step 1: big head, dagger bill - go to the kingfishers
scenes.body: Step 2: black-and-white all over - pied kingfisher.

scenes.headline: Two black breast bands = male. One band = female.
Field-guide skills, taught on our day trails around Bengaluru

caption:
Your field guide can tell you more than the name

Pied kingfishers hunt with a hover-plunge: they drop lower and lower over the water, then dive.

Source: Animal Diversity Web. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Product demo of a field guide in use - a 3-step ID workflow ending in a real field mark. Clip is Uganda (Queen Elizabeth NP); we don't sex the bird on screen, only teach the rule.
